entities.name: José Antonio Bermúdez de Castro
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Antonio Bermúdez de Castro Fernández is a Spanish politician of the People's Party, current deputy for Salamanca. He is the son of the former deputy of the People's Coalition, Pilar Fernández Labrador and descendant of José Bermúdez de Castro Rascón, who was also a deputy and senator in the late nineteenth century, during the Restoration.
